short_description:
Where to buy clothes in GTA 6: two shops sit in Key Lento's county (Mariana County): Billie's Key Lento Gift Shop for casual/street wear and Nifty Threads Island Wear, a thrift store. Guides count 67 clothing stores across Leonida in five styles: casual/street, sportswear, formal, souvenir/swim and thrift. No story spoilers.

Sources: Gamertweak, PowerPyx, TheClick, Sportskeeda.

Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides).
